meta.title: Errand.markets — The marketplace for getting things done
meta.description: Post an errand at your price, a verified Runner accepts, and you pay only when it's done. Now in {region}.

brand.name: Errand.markets
brand.tagline: The marketplace for getting things done.

nav.label: Main
nav.notificationsCount: Notifications ({count, plural, one {# unread} other {# unread}})

market.label: Market
market.pickerTitle: Where do you need things done?
market.pickerLead: Choose your market to see local prices and service areas. You can change this any time.
market.pickerMore: More countries are on the way.

hero.eyebrow: The marketplace for getting things done
hero.title: Got something to do? Let someone do it for you.
hero.lead: Post an errand at your price. A verified Runner nearby accepts it, and your payment is held until you confirm the job is done.

ledger.title: Example errand
ledger.held: Your payment stays on hold until you confirm.

how.title: From to-do to done, in five steps.

post.title: Post your errand
post.body: Say what you need, where and when, and set the price you're willing to pay. Drop a pin and add a landmark so your Runner finds you.

offers.title: A Runner accepts
offers.body: The first verified Runner nearby to accept your price takes the errand. No reply? Raise your price any time before someone accepts.

pay.title: Pay upfront
pay.body: Your money is held, not paid out, until the job is done.

track.title: Track and chat
track.body: Message your Runner, follow progress, and get photo proof when it's finished.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: Confirm and your Runner gets paid. If something's wrong, raise a dispute and our team steps in.

shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.description: Groceries, household items and market runs. Your Runner shares the receipt.

pickup.name: Pickups
pickup.description: Collect orders, parcels and items from shops or people.

documents.name: Documents
documents.description: Collect or drop off documents at offices and agencies.

delivery.name: Deliveries
delivery.description: Send something across town, door to door.

business.name: Business tasks
business.description: Office runs, supplies and errands for your business.

runner.title: Earn by getting things done nearby.
runner.lead: Accept the errands you want at the price shown, and get paid to your bank account once the customer confirms. Buying items? You're reimbursed for the receipt amount.

trust.title: Built so both sides can trust the deal.

escrow.title: Payment held until done
escrow.body: You pay upfront. The Runner is paid only after you confirm, or automatically if you don't respond in time.

verified.title: Verified Runners
verified.body: Every Runner passes an ID and selfie check before taking their first errand.

proof.title: Proof of completion
proof.body: Runners upload a photo when the job is done, and receipts for anything they buy.

ratings.title: Ratings both ways
ratings.body: Customers and Runners rate each other after every errand.

disputes.title: Disputes, handled
disputes.body: If something goes wrong, payment is frozen until our team resolves it.

report.title: Report and block
report.body: Report anyone who breaks the rules, and block people you don't want to work with.

business.title: An extra pair of hands, on demand.
business.lead: Send documents, restock supplies and handle runs across town without adding staff.
business.soon: Business accounts with team access and monthly invoicing are coming soon.

rides.title: Rides
rides.body: Get where you're going with the same account and the same trusted people.

sandbox.banner: Sandbox — no real SMS or identity checks.
sandbox.codeBody: No SMS was sent. Use this code: {code}
sandbox.kycLead: No real verification happens here. Pick the result the provider would send, then submit. This sends a signed webhook through the normal pipeline.
sandbox.name: Name on document

post.title: Post an errand
post.lead: Say what you need. Set the price you're willing to pay — the first verified Runner to accept it takes the job.
post.titleHint: For example “Collect my passport from the embassy”.
post.descriptionHint: What exactly should the Runner do? Anything they should know?
post.buying: The Runner needs to buy things for me
post.itemsHint: The Runner pays at the shop with their own money and is reimbursed for the receipt amount when you confirm.
post.pickupTitle: Where should the Runner go first? (optional)
post.areaHint: We currently operate in these areas.
post.locationOutside: Your location is outside our service areas. Choose an area instead.
post.locationDenied: Location unavailable. Choose an area instead.
post.landmarkHint: For example “Blue gate opposite Shoprite Jabi, 2nd floor”.
post.priceHint: What you'll pay the Runner for the errand ({code}). A {rate} service fee is added. You can raise the price later if nobody accepts.
post.photosHint: Up to 3. Photos are compressed and location data is removed.
